Subject: Demo request — recommendation/search tier (trial signup)

Hi Olga + Marissa,

Thanks for the product — we signed up for the self-serve trial this week and saw promising latency numbers. I’m Daniel on the infra/ML side at FlowRetail. We’d like a 30-minute walkthrough focused on production deployment considerations for recommendation + search re-ranking. High level:
- Primary use case: product search ranking + personalization layer for web & mobile
- Current footprint: ~5k daily active users on the storefront; peak load expected to be ~40–60 QPS for ranking requests during promos
- Timeline: aiming for a POC in January and production by end of Q1 if results look good

Can someone share availability next week? Ideally a morning PST slot. Also please flag any pre-demo info you need (example queries, traffic profile, security checklist).

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Lead ML Engineer — FlowRetail Inc.

Hi Daniel — great to meet you (virtually) and glad the trial is looking useful. I can run a 30-minute technical demo and cover deployment patterns, latency/cost tradeoffs, and what a POC looks like. Before we lock in a slot, a couple quick questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Are the ranking requests single-turn text prompts or do you include stored metadata/feature vectors? Approx tokens per request?
2) Expected steady-state qps and expected peak qps during promos — you mentioned 40–60 peak; will that be sustained or short bursts?
3) Monthly tokens (rough estimate) or monthly requests so we can scope cost examples
4) Security requirements: SOC 2 / HIPAA / data residency constraints? Any compliance docs we should prepare?
5) Who should join from your side for infra/security (e.g., Luke Emerson) and product/ML?

Proposed 30-min slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 8, 10:00–10:30 AM
- Wed Dec 9, 9:00–9:30 AM
- Wed Dec 9, 11:00–11:30 AM

Or feel free to pick an open time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/olga-30min

I attached a one-pager that outlines what we’ll cover so folks can prep.

Thanks — I’ll keep it focused and demo the exact config that matches search + rerank workloads.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@flowretail.com>

Olga — quick answers below, thanks for the fast reply. Attaching a small network diagram and sample trial metrics.

1) Request shape: we send feature vectors + a short textual query; average token payload ~120 tokens per request (including embeddings/metadata).
2) Steady-state qps: ~10–15 qps; peaks up to 50–60 qps for ~10–20 minute flash sales windows. Bursts are short but can be frequent during promotions.
3) Monthly estimates: ~25M requests -> ~3.0B tokens (very rough) based on current growth projections.
4) Compliance: SOC 2 required; we also need SSO (SAML) and regional control (prefer us-west for initial rollout).
5) Stakeholders: Luke Emerson (cc’d) for infra/networking and Sarah Kim on ML engineering (not cc’d yet).

Preferred slot: Wed Dec 9, 11:00–11:30 AM PST works best for Luke & me.

Attachments: network-reqs.pdf; poe_trial_metrics.csv

Let me know if you need anything else ahead of the demo.

—Daniel
